full_prompt_en: A square, dark-framed oil painting shows a smiling curly-haired child leaning on a table against a quiet brown interior background. The narrow wooden frame remains visible around all four sides, its reddish-brown edge separating the painted scene from a plain blue-gray surround. Inside the frame, the upper background is a soft, uninterrupted field of smoky umber, darkest behind the child's cap and lighter beside the face. Near the upper center, a small dark cap rests over short, springy blond-brown curls. The child's round face looks toward the viewer with half-lowered eyes, rosy cheeks, a pink nose, and a restrained, playful smile. One hand props the chin while the other arm folds across the tabletop. A muted blue-green jacket fills the center and lower right, with pale textured trim at the broad collar and cuffs. Its long sleeves wrinkle into soft horizontal bands around the bent arms. The table makes a steady horizontal strip along the lower part of the painted scene. At the lower left, a clear drinking glass holding a little amber liquid stands on a small dark dish beside two round yellow-orange pieces of fruit. Just behind the glass, a small pale, woolly animal looks out from the shadow at the child's side; only its head and upper body are clearly visible. A reddish-brown form is partly hidden near the right edge behind the child. Gentle light comes from the upper left and front, brightening the face, cuff, animal, and glass rim while the wall and far side of the jacket remain in soft shade. The face is smoothly modeled, but the clothing trim and curls carry finer, broken touches of paint. Bright accents are kept small against broad brown and green-gray areas, so the child's expression stays central. The overall composition is close, balanced, and affectionate, with tactile oil-paint detail and subdued interior color supporting the playful encounter.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅带深色画框的方形油画呈现一个卷发孩子，微笑着伏在桌前，身后是安静的褐色室内背景。窄窄的木框四边都可见，红褐色边缘将画中场景与外侧朴素的蓝灰色环境分开。画框内的上部背景是连续柔和的烟褐色域，在孩子帽子后方最暗，在脸旁较亮。上部中央附近，一顶小小的深色帽子盖在短而富有弹性的浅棕金色卷发上。孩子圆润的脸朝向观者，眼皮略垂，脸颊泛红，鼻子粉红，带着克制而俏皮的笑意。一只手托住下巴，另一只手臂交叠在桌面上。低调蓝绿色外套占据中央和右下，宽阔衣领及袖口饰有浅色、有肌理的镶边。长袖在弯起的手臂周围皱成柔和横向衣褶。桌面在画中场景下部形成稳定的水平色带。左下角，一个装有少量琥珀色液体的透明玻璃杯立在小小的深色盘子上，旁边有两枚圆形黄橙色水果。杯子后方，一只浅色、毛茸茸的小动物从孩子身旁的阴影里望出，只有头和上半身清晰可见。孩子后方右缘附近，一块红褐色形体部分被遮住。柔光从左上及前方照来，照亮脸、袖口、小动物和玻璃杯边缘，墙面与外套远侧仍留在柔和阴影中。脸部塑形平滑，而衣物镶边与卷发带有更细碎的颜料痕迹。明亮重音在宽阔的褐色与灰绿色区域中保持小面积，使孩子的表情仍是中心。整体构图亲近、均衡而充满亲昵感，触手可感的油画细节和低调室内色彩衬托这场俏皮相遇。
style_prompt_en: The oil-painted treatment uses a deep warm-brown ground and softened green-gray areas to hold a few small, luminous accents. Flesh-toned highlights are smoothly blended into warm shadows, while curls, woven trim, and reflective surfaces are built from shorter, broken marks. A close central form is anchored by a firm horizontal band near the lower edge, and rounded details gather to one side without upsetting the balance. Most edges soften gently into the dark background, yet selected rims and bright folds stay crisp enough to lead the eye. The light is diffuse and frontal from one side, giving rounded surfaces quiet volume rather than theatrical glare. Reddish wood tones, muted teal, amber, cream, and dusty rose enrich the otherwise restrained earthy palette. Fine texture appears selectively around tactile materials, leaving broad background passages calm. The overall effect is intimate and playful, with careful tonal modeling and small material contrasts carrying the visual energy.
style_prompt_zh: 油画表现以深暖褐色底面和柔化的灰绿色区域承托少量明亮重音。肤色高光平滑地融入暖阴影，卷曲、编织镶边和反光表面则由较短、破碎的笔痕组成。靠近观者的中央形体由下缘附近一道明确的水平带稳住，圆润细节聚在一侧，却不破坏均衡。多数边缘轻轻融入深色背景，少数轮缘与明亮褶痕仍足够清晰，能够引导视线。光从一侧以前方漫射方式照来，赋予圆润表面安静体积，而非戏剧性眩光。红褐木色、低调青绿、琥珀、奶油白和灰粉丰富原本克制的大地色调。细微肌理有选择地落在可触的材质上，让宽阔背景保持平静。整体效果亲近而俏皮，细致的明度塑形和小面积材质反差承载视觉活力。
theme_en: A smiling child at a table with a small animal and glass
theme_zh: 微笑的孩子与小动物、玻璃杯同处桌前
name: Pieter-Jansz van Asch
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
